messages:
elaine-peopleops: Quick Q — Sam has an IC (Mohammed) approved for a band bump effective 2026-07-01. Sam asked if we should request retro to 7/1 or just make it effective 7/15.
sam-engmgr: We want internal consistency with offers going out 7/02. Is retro a big lift?
mohammed-ic: Also want to know if a retro pay affects my 401k deferrals / pre-tax contributions.
kavi-peopleops: Short: retro is doable but requires paperwork + payroll cutoff. For 7/1 retro to land on 7/15 payroll, comp change + approvals must be in Workday and approved by the payroll cutoff (usually the 10th).
payroll-bot: FYI: due to an upcoming vendor blackout the cutoff for 2026-07-15 run is 2026-07-08. Changes after that process on 2026-08-15.
sam-engmgr: Ok — I'll try to get signoffs by 7/07. What exactly do you need attached?
kavi-peopleops: Manager approval email, calibration note or rubric excerpt, completed Workday comp change form flagged "retro", and please CC hr-escalations + payroll. Put "retro pay requested 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-14" in the notes. PDFs only.
mohammed-ic: About 401k — will the employer match for the retro period be adjusted?
elaine-peopleops: Employer match follows payroll contributions. If retro increases your gross pay for that period, payroll will recalculate contributions and match will be applied in that run subject to plan limits. If you maxed deferrals earlier in the year, there could be plan-year impacts; payroll will flag any anomalies.
sam-engmgr: Does band change auto-trigger a new equity grant or bonus target change?
kavi-peopleops: Band change updates comp and typically bonus target adjusts with new comp. Equity refreshes are separate approvals; we don't auto-grant equity on promotion. Vesting for existing grants doesn't reset unless a new grant is issued.
mohammed-ic: Any manager follow-up required after the change posts?
elaine-peopleops: Yes — policy asks managers to run a 30/60 check-in, update the growth doc, and note the promotion in the team's calibration notes.
sam-engmgr: Great, filing tonight. Thanks all :thumbsup:
payroll-bot: Reminder: attach PDFs only; non-PDFs delay processing.
